newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican president orders probe into attacks on press.
newsitem.headline: Mexican president orders probe into attacks on press.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo on Thursday ordered an investigation into recent scuffles between his military bodyguards and his press pool, the president's office said on Thursday.
Local newspapers said the bodyguards have beaten up reporters in the past week on presidential trips.
Three reporters were attacked on Wednesday by the president's bodyguards at the inauguration of a bridge outside the capital, left-wing newspaper La Jornada said said.
"Reporter Juan Garcia had his mouth broken after being shoved and punched," the paper said.
"The president of the republic ordered the chief of his military bodyguards to make the necessary investigations," the president's office said in a statement on Thursday.
The statement promised to "apply appropriate disciplinary measures," if the guards are found responsible.
La Jornada said the military guards punched other reporters who follow the president in a separate incident while on a trip to the northern state of Chihuahua.
